Discover More

Information for current and new students, staff, alumni and businesses.

Global Education

UTM is offering five types of mobility programs which allow UTM Students to go abroad and join academic programs in universities, institutions or organizations all over the world.

Alumni Relations

Our alumni often serve as powerful ambassadors for UTM brand for years. Alumni Relations team aims to build an engaging alumni community to connect with each other and with the university.

Future-Oriented Graduates

UTM aims to produce multi-talented graduates by improving the quality of delivery of teaching and learning, and implementing innovative curriculum assessments through data analytics.

Research & Innovations

Advancing knowledge and solutions through impactful research and groundbreaking innovations.

Research Showcase

UTM NEXUS Search is the university’s searchable database of experts and researchers. Find an expert by name, field of interests or by publication. 

Our Experts

Discover the talented experts behind our success, dedicated to transforming ideas into meaningful, lasting impact for our community worldwide.

Labs & Facilities

We provide facilities and laboratory services for analysis, scientific and engineering testing, advisory services for students, researchers and community.
